svg.text: AI Suggestions & Quick Edit: from keystroke to AI and back
editor/extensions/ · api/suggestion · api/quick-edit — CodeMirror state, two routes, Groq
A file is open in the code editor
suggestion(fileName) → suggestionState, debounce + render plugins, Tab
quickEdit() → quickEditState, prompt tooltip, Mod-k keymap
selectionTooltip() → the toolbar under a selection
keymap.of([indentWithTab]) ← AFTER suggestion, so Tab tries it first
in a list; their order sets
Type a character (or move the cursor)
suggestionState.update → any old suggestion becomes null (hidden)
debounce plugin update → trigger(): clear the timer, abort the request,
text selected? → stop · else setTimeout(…, 600 ms)
600 ms pass with no typing → the timer fires
generatePayload(view, fileName): fileName, whole code, current line,
5 lines before / after, text before / after the cursor, lineNumber
zod checks the payload → fetch POST (10 s timeout, Clerk cookie sent)
aborted → return null quietly · other error → toast.error(…)
auth() → no user? 401 · zod → bad input? 400
controller.signal.aborted? → drop the answer (the user typed meanwhile)
→ suggestionState = "a + b" → render plugin rebuilds its decorations
→ Decoration.widget(SuggestionWidget) at the cursor: faded ghost text
The ghost text is drawn, not
typed: it isn't part of the
acceptSuggestionKeymap: a suggestion? → insert it at the cursor,
move the cursor to its end, setSuggestionEffect.of(null) → true
no suggestion → return false → indentWithTab indents instead
suggestionState → null · debounce plugin: text selected → no request
selectionTooltipField → [Quick Edit Ctrl+K] under the selection
Click Quick Edit, or press Ctrl/⌘ K
→ quickEditState = true → the toolbar hides, the prompt tooltip shows
createPromptView(view): <form> input + Cancel + Submit · input focused
{ from, to } = the selection · selectedCode, fullCode, instruction
(30 s timeout · aborted → null · error → toast)
aborted (Cancel / Escape / selection changed)? → change nothing
view.dispatch({ changes: { from, to, insert: editedCode },
Any document change (typed, Tab-accepted, or Quick Edit)
1.5 s debounce (or switching files) → updateFile({ id, content })
→ Convex patches the files row (Chapter 10, unchanged)
